name: Kho ca loc
summary: Dried snakehead from the Đồng Tháp Mười part of the province. About 3 to 4 kg of fresh fish make 1 kg of dried fish, sunned for 3 to 4 days. Whole pieces and shredded pieces are the two cuts the provincial tourism center prefers. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The center places the drying yards along kênh 79 and at chợ Bình Hiệp, Bàu Sậy, Gò Châu Mai, khu phố Rọc Chanh, and chợ Tân Hưng. The homepage had grouped khô cá lóc with the old Long An goods. This is not lunch at the Holy See.
texture: Enough sun leaves the flesh dry, still springy, not shriveled, naturally yellow-brown, and firm. The center says a piece that is too soft or wet has not had enough sun.
taste: The sweetness it names is the field fish. The cure is salt, sugar, MSG, pepper, and chili, and each house has its own mix. One source only.
howToEat: Carry it, or eat it as gỏi xoài, fried with mắm me, tossed with sầu đâu leaves, or in a sour soup. Those plates are separate dishes.
A price is Check on arrival. The hour at a table was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Kênh 79, chợ Bình Hiệp, Bàu Sậy, Gò Châu Mai, khu phố Rọc Chanh, and chợ Tân Hưng. The center also says the plates are served in orchard and countryside tourism spots, without naming one.
seoTitle: Kho ca loc from Dong Thap Muoi
seoDescription: Dried snakehead along kênh 79, 3 to 4 days of sun, whole or shredded. The homepage also groups it with old Long An goods. A price is Check on arrival.
